# Bundled attachment parsers

- PDF.js 5.6.205 — https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js — Apache-2.0 (license in pdfjs/LICENSE).
- JSZip 3.10.1 — https://github.com/Stuk/jszip — MIT option (license in jszip/LICENSE.markdown).

Copied from the locally available dependency runtime. These browser distributions are included so the Windows program can parse files without Python, Office, a network download, or a separate Node installation. Keep their license files when redistributing.
